text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre was stuck in a slump, so I took her to visit a shrine, thinking it might help refresh her spirits.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh, this is—
choice_data_list: Is something wrong with the shrine doors?
Is something wrong with the shrine doors?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Gold ornamental fittings.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Intricate patterns, a noble luster.
You can truly see the craftsman's skill.

...Fufu.
Who would've thought I'd run into Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Elder Sister.
What a coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I ended up here while lost in thought.
...Were you looking at the ornamental fittings?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your fascination with goldwork
hasn't changed a bit since back then, has it?
choice_data_list: I've been interested in it since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My father is a goldsmith,
so I often had opportunities to see such work.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I gave Orfe a gift
when we were little... Though naturally,
she probably doesn't remember."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...A gold-plated ring.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This must be an offering from my dear sister.
...I remember this.

text_block_list.name: Young Orfe
text_block_list.text: —This ring is a gift for Us.

text_block_list.name: Young Journey
text_block_list.text:
I made it in arts and crafts class.
It's not real gold, but it's pretty, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Orfe
text_block_list.text:
"...A brilliance truly worthy of a king.
You have my thanks, dear sister."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Though I had forgotten it
until Elder Sister spoke of it."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: To think you remembered... I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'll gift you more again someday.
Gold-leaf tableware, brass buttons...
Golden hues that suit you so well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...That is splendid.
I have high expectations for you, Sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps reminiscing about her older sister refreshed her spirits.
From that day forward, Orfevre began
returning to top form.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
............
I have no recollection of that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's understandable.
That was a very long time ago, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she was troubled by being unable to recall memories of her older sister.
Orfevre's slump
continued on...
